title: DSR (Direct Seeded Rice) or Crop Diversification to Maize/Moong
why: Paddy flooded basins consume ~1,200 mm water. Switching 15-25% of acreage to DSR or Maize cuts water demand by 40-50% while protecting farm income.

source.name: Punjab Agricultural University (PAU) Crop Diversification Advisory

reasons: Validated across Punjab pilot agro-climatic zones

title: Community Village Pond Rejuvenation & Managed Aquifer Recharge (MAR)
why: De-silting existing village ponds and constructing injection wells directs monsoon peak runoff into the shallow alluvial aquifer instead of allowing evaporation loss.

source.name: Mission Amrit Sarovar & CGWB Master Plan for Artificial Recharge

reasons: Soil infiltration rate varies across silt-clay layers

title: Solar-Powered Drip Irrigation with Tensiometer Soil-Moisture Scheduling
why: Replacing flood irrigation with micro-irrigation and tensiometers prevents over-irrigation during early vegetative and reproductive phases.

source.name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY) Per Drop More Crop

reasons: Requires capital subsidy and regular maintenance
